entry.name: Fractional part of square root of a(n) starts with 2: first term of runs.
First of four sequences representing the lexicographical minimal decomposition of n in 4 squares: n = a(n)^2 + A064874(n)^2 + A064875(n)^2 + A064876(n)^2.
entry.text: Conjecture: a(n) = A064874(n - A064874(n)^2). - _Zhuorui He_, Oct 23 2025

Number of permutations of length n with 1 fixed and 1 reflected point.
a(n) is the multiplicative inverse of A001844(n) modulo A001844(n+1); where A001844 is the sequence of centered square numbers.
a(n) is the number of n-step walks on square lattice such that 0 <= y <= x at each step.

Start with a single square for n=0; for the odd n-th generation add a square at each expandable vertex of the squares of the (n-1)-th generation (this is the "vertex to vertex" version); for the even n-th generation use the "side to vertex" version; a(n) is the number of squares added in the n-th ge
Central terms of triangle A181544.
entry.text: Conjecture D-finite with recurrence: n^3*a(n) - (2*n-1)*(13*n^2-13*n+4)*a(n-1) - 3*(n-1)*(3*n-4)*(3*n-2)*a(n-2) = 0. - _R. J. Mathar_, May 15 2016

entry.name: a(n) is the number of unlabeled rank-3 graded lattices with 4 coatoms and n atoms.
a(n) is the number of unlabeled rank-3 graded lattices with 5 coatoms and n atoms.

Take n-th prime p, let P(p) = all primes that can be obtained by permuting the digits of p and possibly adding or omitting zeros; a(n) = |p-q| where q in P(p) is the closest to p but different from p (a(n)=0 if no such q exists).
entry.text: Conjecture: a(n) > 0 for n > 4. - _Sean A. Irvine_, Nov 23 2021

entry.name: Number of degree-n permutations with exactly one even cycle.
Number of cycles in all non-derangement permutations of {1,2,...,n}.
Number of derangements of {1,2,...,n} having no adjacent 3-cycles (an adjacent 3-cycle is a cycle of the form (i,i+1,i+2)).
entry.text: Conjecture: D-finite with recurrence a(n) = (n-1)*a(n-1) + (n-1)*a(n-2) + a(n-3) + (n-1)*a(n-4) + 2*a(n-6). - _R. J. Mathar_, Jul 26 2022

entry.name: Number of derangements of {1,2,...,n} having no adjacent 4-cycles (an adjacent 4-cycle is a cycle of the form (i,i+1,i+2,i+3)).
entry.text: Conjecture: D-finite with recurrence a(n) = (n-1)*a(n-1) + (n-1)*a(n-2) + 2*a(n-4) + (n-1)*a(n-5) + 3*a(n-8). - _R. J. Mathar_, Jul 26 2022

entry.name: Complement and reverse the order of all but the most significant bit in binary expansion of n. n = 1ab..yz -> 1ZY..BA = a(n), where A = 1-a, B = 1-b, ... .
Number of derangements of {1,2,...,n} having no adjacent transpositions.
